title: Route multi question chats
subtitle: Split one message into topics, pass inputs, orchestrate, and validate changes in the backend.

steps.title: Split one message into topics
steps.evidence: split order status, address updates and refund policy into focused topics

steps.title: Define inputs and outputs
steps.evidence: The example passes OrderId into status lookup, and OrderId plus NewDeliveryAddress and CustomerVerified into address update.

steps.title: Route with orchestration
steps.evidence: It can separate the requests into different topic paths in classic orchestration or plan across multiple capabilities in generative orchestration.

steps.title: Validate business rules outside
steps.evidence: The backend checks order existence, ownership and eligibility before any change.
